summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for annual-interest fix on public URL. Verified admin login, creating 1,000,000 deposit at 20% annual (2026-01-01 to 2027-01-01), current-year report math (annual 200000, January 30 days and 16438.20), statements annual-interest behavior, and setup installer validity.
action_items: Optional maintenance: rename backend field monthly_interest_rate to annual_interest_rate across API/contracts to reduce ambiguity and future regression risk.
Clean up CALC_/UI test deposits from database if a manual cleanup policy is required (no delete endpoint exposed).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend calculation logic is correct for requested fix: annual interest = amount * rate/100, daily = floor((annual/365)*100)/100, monthly row = daily * active_days with active_days capped at 30.

Naming mismatch remains in code contract (monthly_interest_rate, monthly_interest_amount) while business meaning is annual; this is a readability/maintainability risk, not a functional failure in current scope.
Large monolithic backend file (/app/backend/server.py, >700 lines) still increases change-risk for financial calculations.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 pytest for targeted fix + setup download endpoint 200/MZ)

seed_data_creation: Created CALC-DEP-* via backend pytest and UI-DEP-204104 via UI flow for Banque Misr.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI and API values rendered in Arabic numerals (e.g., ٢٠٠٬٠٠٠٫٠٠), so numeric assertions should normalize locale-aware formatting. No MOCKED API observed.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issue in this scope. Historical mismatch came from treating annual rate with non-daily-prorated monthly logic; current implementation now follows annual/365 with daily truncation and 30-day monthly cap as required.
